prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1182; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred involving your insured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, including any applicable excess or umbrella coverage. We also request a complete copy of the declarations page for that policy.

Your company is hereby on notice of a potential claim and is obligated to preserve all evidence relating to the accident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, repair estimates, and any electronic communications. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or destroyed while this matter is pending. We look forward to your prompt response.
